summary: Proposes an experimental extension to TCP that offers partial ordering, where some data must arrive in order but other data need not. It presents the idea to encourage discussion of its usefulness. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 6247.

eli5.summary: Normally TCP hands over everything in strict order. This idea lets some pieces arrive in any order, like picking up grocery bags in any order but the eggs before the bread.

questions: what is partial order service in tcp
